hooks.command: bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [[ -z "$f" ]] && exit 0; echo "$f" | grep -qE "\.env$|\.env\.local$" && { echo "BLOCKED: Cannot edit .env files directly. Use .env.example instead." >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0'
bash -c 'cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); [[ -z "$cmd" ]] && exit 0; echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "rm\s+-rf\s+/" && { echo "BLOCKED: Dangerous rm -rf / command" >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0'
bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [[ -z "$f" ]] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx oxlint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; exit 0'
bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [[ -z "$f" ]] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.py) ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; exit 0'
